# Step - export_graphson

`export_graphson` · category: [Graph information and files](../../traversal/step_reference.md#graph-information-and-files)

Writes the whole graph to a GraphSON file at the given path (needs file access).

## Forms

```text
export_graphson(arg1: string)
```

## Example

```rhai
g.export_graphson("modern.json")
```

- [GraphSON](../../users_guide/graphson.md)
